title: Looking for ml engineering help: RAG
output:
I have what I need. The client is verified (46 jobs, 30 hires, 4.71 rating, $27k spend) — a solid, legitimate client. The job is a genuine ML engineering task (RAG + OpenAI API + Redis + defect detection). I have strong matching evidence: a production defect-detection system [case_proj_65c5a1c7a6] and a production RAG assistant using OpenAI API [case_proj_3adc72b41f].

Note: the post is a bit muddled (a "marketing agency" wanting production-line defect detection), but the technical requirements are clear and match my portfolio. I'll bid at the upper end of the budget given the 6-week, 4-milestone scope.

---

**Proposal**

Hi — your brief maps directly to two production systems I've shipped.

For the defect-detection core, I built a production computer-vision pipeline that detects defects from photos taken on a production line, using PyTorch and AWS SageMaker; it caught 48% of defects before packing [case_proj_65c5a1c7a6]. I can adapt that architecture to your line's camera feed and defect classes.

For the RAG layer, I delivered a production RAG assistant built on LangChain, Qdrant, the OpenAI API, and FastAPI that answered 241 staff questions a week [case_proj_3adc72b41f]. I'll use Redis for caching and as a fast vector/lookup store to keep latency low and cut OpenAI token costs.

On your screening questions: a similar project is the assembly-line defect detector above [case_proj_65c5a1c7a6]. I test that results work via a labeled holdout set with precision/recall/F1 targets, a regression suite, and a small human-in-the-loop review of flagged images before each milestone sign-off.

I can structure this as your 4 milestones over 6 weeks: (1) data + baseline detector, (2) RAG + Redis integration, (3) tuning + evaluation, (4) deployment + docs.

Happy to start with a short paid discovery task if useful.

DECISION: bid
PRICE: 2600
